job: Show the detail of something picked from a list without losing the list.
purpose: A native dialog that slides in from the right at 420px (560px for wide content), from the left for navigation and filters, and from the bottom on phones. By default it is modal: Escape, a close button and a backdrop click close it. With data-modeless it opens beside a live page, with no scrim, scroll lock or focus trap. Focus never opens on a footer action. It can run in steps and fires fd:open, fd:close and fd:change.
useWhen: A row in a table or a log opens its full detail beside the list.
A filter or navigation panel slides in from the left on a small screen.
A detail panel opens beside something the person keeps working with, such as a map, a canvas or a list, and stays open while they pick other items (data-modeless).
A multi-step flow needs more room than a dialog.

avoidWhen.when: A short question that needs a yes or no.
A panel anchored to a button.
A permanent side panel that is part of the layout.

states.name: modeless
states.how: data-modeless on the sheet; opened with show(), so the page behind stays live

states.name: dragging
states.how: data-dragging while a phone sheet is pulled down

states.name: step
states.how: data-step on a section; [data-fd-dialog-step] buttons move between steps

variants.useWhen: Detail of a row; the default.
Wide content such as a response body, 560px.
On a footer child: pushes it to the start edge, as a secondary action.
A detail panel beside a map, a canvas or a list the person keeps using: no scrim, scroll lock or focus trap, outside clicks do not close it, and below 640px it stops at about half the screen.

parts.role: A compact title row with the title and controls, used in place of the head.
A muted line under the title.
A titled group inside the body.

keyboard.does: Closes the sheet and returns focus to the trigger. A modeless sheet closes only when focus is inside it and no menu or popover is open.
Stays inside a modal sheet. A modeless sheet lets focus leave.
